contract.inputs: framebuffer.bin plus JSON geometry base, stride, width, height, depth. Stride is bytes. File size must equal stride*height.
contract.depth: Low 8 bits must be 30 or 32. 30 uses m1n1 src/fb.c pixel2rgb_30: R=(pixel>>22)&255, G=(pixel>>12)&255, B=(pixel>>2)&255. 32 uses pixel2rgb_24: R=(pixel>>16)&255, G=(pixel>>8)&255, B=pixel&255. Pixels are little-endian u32.
contract.bounds: width, height, stride, and file size each must be in 1..64MiB
contract.output: stdlib zlib PNG created with O_EXCL. An existing path is left unchanged. The raw file is only read.
contract.receipt: physical_panel_observed and panel_proof stay false. A metadata claim that the panel was observed is ignored.

note: The PNG is a host view of captured firmware framebuffer bytes. It is not evidence the 13-inch panel scanned those pixels out.
